answer: The registry issues identity through a jade-sealed gale exam. First, an applicant buys one jade seal for $50, bound to one key and one device, after a document check. Second, the seal unlocks a 10-minute gale exam: 40 questions, one every 15 seconds, drawn along the trellis linking the applicant's prior work to its reviewers, with branching follow-ups no script can pre-answer. Passing mints the identity; failing burns the seal and bars reapplication for an epoch. Forging 1,000 puppets costs $50,000 plus 1,000 checks and 1,000 exams, with no bulk discount, while an honest user pays $50 once.
